metadata.description: Text corrigendum to Continuity Instrument (CI) v1.0.0 (version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23651305). The future integration target written "BACON" in 31 uppercase occurrences across 17 bound text files is Beacon (Beacon Profile v0.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18933553, with version/concept role unresolved). Nine edits revise boundary statements to identify the published referent; statements that no public canonical definition had been found are withdrawn. CI v1.0.0 still provides no CI-to-Beacon mapping, adapter or compatibility result. The correction leaves the implementation, schemas, tests, evidence status, claim ceilings and original component rights unchanged. The separate supplement preserves predecessor bytes and supplies the exact correction specification, reviewed corrected copies and maintenance tooling. It does not replace the CI v1.0.0 deposit or frozen mirror.

corrigendum_record.submission_note: The owner creates a separate record, supplies its assigned DOI and chooses the actual publication date. Then finalize the DOI-bearing Markdown and academic PDF, assembled package and checksums. The owner uploads the final individual files and publishes after Preview verification. The candidate has no assigned corrigendum DOI and is not a new CI version.
